title: Morriscastle Village, Kilmuckridge, Co. Wexford
description:
One property in sought after Morriscastle Village back to the market.

Beautiful 4 Bedroom Split Level house with landscaped garden in Morriscastle Village. 1GB Fibre Optic to the home options available - live beside a beautiful beach an hour from Dublin and in one of the most prestigious developments in North County Wexford.

Available furnished or unfurnished. Smaller living room style.

Architect designed house with its own private enclosed garden with barbecue,patio and patio furniture. All Gas Central Heating and open fire.

This property is secured by electronic gates and approached down a beautiful willow lined drive adjacent to its own 18 hole par 3 course. 

Access to our adjoining Tennis Club with two Astro Turf Courts and our Par Three golf course is also included in rental.

The blue flag Morriscastle Beach is a ten minute walk from the house among many other beautiful beaches in the area.

The local village is served by two well stocked local supermarkets, two excellent schools one primary and one secondary, a coffee shop and busy hotel. The village also has number of creches and excellent childcare day facilities. School bus to and from Gorey and Wexford towns each day.
Active GAA soccer and drama clubs enhance the vibrant local community.

Access to our farm and private walks available for tenants.

Excellent transport links on M11 Motorway and just over 60 minutes drive to Dublin. Also 20 minutes to Gorey train station if you wish to travel to Dublin by train. Excellent references required and accepted only.

Included annual membership to the Par 3 golf.

PLEASE NOTE - Viewings for this property must be arranged by prior appointment.
